common.seo_title: The Complete Guide to Decants: How to Find Your Perfect Perfume?
common.seo_p1: Welcome to ml_tlv, Israel's leading center for perfume enthusiasts. We specialize in decants and perfume samples.
common.seo_p2: The perfume industry has undergone an incredible transformation in recent years. While we once settled for mainstream brands known from Duty-Free, today the Israeli audience seeks depth, uniqueness, and a story behind every spray. Niche perfumes (Niche Perfumery) are the heartbeat of our collection. Brands like Xerjoff, Roja, Creed, and Amouage are no longer names reserved only for European royalty; thanks to our decants, anyone can hold a piece of fragrant art in their pocket.
common.seo_why_samples_desc: Purchasing a perfume sample is not just an economic saving, but a smart consumer decision. Often, a perfume smells wonderful on a sample paper in the store, but completely changes its character upon contact with the skin after half an hour. By using decants of 2ml, 5ml, or 10ml, you give your skin the time to get to know the heart and base notes of the perfume.
common.seo_p3: At ml_tlv, we adhere to high standards of hygiene and precision. Every decant is produced directly from the original bottle only, without mixing and without changing the liquid's composition. We use high-quality glass bottles with a spray (atomizer) that ensures an even distribution of the scent, allowing you to enjoy a usage experience identical to that of the original bottle. This is the perfect solution for travel, evening outings, or simply to build a diverse and rich "perfume wardrobe" without breaking your savings plan.
common.seo_niche_title: Israel's Largest Selection of Niche & Luxury Perfumes
common.seo_p4: Our catalog is hand-picked. We follow the hottest trends in Paris, Milan, and London to bring you niche perfume samples that are hard to find elsewhere. Whether you're looking for the deep oriental scent of Amouage, the royal elegance of Creed Aventus, or the modern sophistication of Maison Francis Kurjkan – you'll find them with us.
common.seo_p5: But ml_tlv is more than just a store; it's a community. Our personal catalogs platform allows avid perfume enthusiasts to open their own store within the site, share their collection, and make their perfumes accessible to others. It's the place where collectors meet, exchange experiences, and discover the "Holy Grail" of the perfume world together. Transparency, security, and reliability are our guiding lights, and we ensure that every product sold through the platform meets our strict standards.
common.seo_experience_title: The Significance of Scent in Daily Life
common.seo_experience_p1: Scent is the strongest sense tied to memory and emotion. Choosing the right perfume can boost confidence, create an unforgettable first impression, and evoke feelings of calm or energy. We believe that every occasion has its matching scent – a fresh and lemony perfume for a morning at the office, a rich and spicy Oud scent for a luxury evening event, or a delicate and floral perfume for a romantic date.
common.seo_experience_p2: We are proud to provide fast shipping to all parts of the country, from Eilat to the Golan Heights.
common.seo_cta: Explore our collection now, begin your journey into the world of niche perfumery.

matching.title: Smart Perfume Matching
matching.description: Our algorithm will find the perfumes that best match your personal taste based on ingredients and notes.
matching.how_it_works: Our advanced algorithm is based on an in-depth analysis of thousands of perfume types, scent notes, and aromatic families. The process combines weightings of top, middle, and base notes alongside extract concentrations to identify unique patterns that trigger your perfect connection to a fragrance. In real-time, the system scans new vintages and current trends, ensuring every recommendation is accurate, personal, and relevant to your evolving preferences. We have created a system that shortens the path to your next signature scent, saving time and trial-and-error in the challenging selection process of the fragrance world.
